caption: The drawing depicts a side profile view of a puppet or marionette head and upper torso. The puppet is wearing a gold-colored, conical helmet with a pointed silver spike at the top, which is slightly bent. Two thin strings extend upward from the helmet, indicating that it is a marionette. The face is characterized by exaggerated features: a pronounced, red nose; thick red lips; a large chin; a prominent eyebrow above a single, wide eye; and a pinkish, uneven skin tone with red and brown shading. The puppet has black, shaggy hair extending down behind the ear. The figure is dressed in a red garment with a yellow star or badge on the chest and a red scarf or cloth draped around the neck. The drawing is rendered on a plain beige background, and the artist’s name, "Elmer Weise," is written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: King Saul Marionette
